original: 憎い憎いは可愛いの裏。

en.text: Hatred is the other side of cuteness.
Those who are cute have a hateful backside.
If you're cute, you're hiding hatred.
If it's cute, it's hiding hatred.
Hatred is the flip side of cuteness.
Hatred is the downside of being cute.

indices: 憎い[01] 憎い[01] は 可愛い(かわいい)[01] の 裏
